notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror launches March 28 on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921182/11457eb25137af06de2ed55da314c8e9476677a6.jpg
Hello, Horror fans!

We’re thrilled to announce that Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror, the newest installment in the Dollhouse series, will officially launch on Steam on March 28, 2025! Prepare to join Eliza on a haunting journey through two nightmarish realities and uncover the twisted mystery of her broken mind. 

To celebrate, we’ve just unveiled a brand-new trailer, offering a glimpse into the immersive gameplay, unsettling challenges, and bone-chilling encounters that await in this psychological horror experience.

[previewyoutube=oIaeFDudFfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to add Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror to your wishlist today to stay updated on all the latest news and prepare yourself for the darkness ahead.

Wishlist NOW
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791660/Dollhouse_Behind_the_Broken_Mirror/

notes.title: Extra Doors?!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

Today there will be an update for the game! When you're done with the "base game", you should be able to access additional content from the main menu. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921182/f9d9d7568eea817530f0116d96aca0592fd8b813.png

I won't tell you much more than this... enjoy! 

[spoiler] The additional content is 3 new levels :) [/spoiler]

The price has also been lowered so more people can play. 

We'll also be streaming the game later today on our YouTube Channel. 

Thanks,
Robert J
Community Manager

notes.title: SOEDESCO at Gamescom 2022!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

This past week we at SOEDESCO have been to Gamescom 2022! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921182/f12c9aafa7732c452151f18ffe56e477ce0316a1.jpg

Bit of a different update this time not about the game but about us at SOEDESCO. 

This year we were only in the B2B area of the event, but we were still able to show our games to other developers and industry insiders. The business area is still important for the press, influencers, and other media to check out our company! 

Next year we hope to bring Soedesco to the customer-facing side of Gamescom as well😊

Here are some of the photos from the event: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921182/41390ccdf8bcf8a9771701b5fb96c4575afb40af.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921182/2749afd4153bd45b44a25ac004827584c4f77c6e.png

Please make sure to check our YouTube channel for the “after movie” of Gamescom 2022! 

YouTube 

Thanks and that’s all for now. 

-	Robert J (Soedesco community manager)
